class.name: EditorToolbar
class.experimental: This editor UI component may change as more editor screens adopt it.
class.brief_description: A responsive, grouped toolbar for editor actions.
class.description: Presents [EditorAction] instances in semantic groups. Each group remains intact while the toolbar wraps in narrow docks or windows.

method.name: add_action
method.description: Adds [param action] to [param group] and returns its button presentation.

method.name: add_custom_control
method.description: Adds an arbitrary [param control] to [param group]. The toolbar takes ownership of the control.

method.name: add_separator
method.description: Adds a visual separator inside [param group].

method.name: clear
method.description: Removes all groups, actions, separators, and custom controls.
